components.css: .ds-project-card { max-width: 360px; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid rgba(13,27,42,.18); border-radius: 15px; background: #edf7ff; color: #0d1b2a; font-family: ui-rounded, Aptos, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), box-shadow 220ms ease; } .ds-project-card:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: 0 18px 38px rgba(0,0,0,.26); } .ds-project-card h3 { margin: 28px 0 12px; font-size: 2rem; line-height: .95; letter-spacing: -.04em; } .ds-project-card a { color: inherit; font-weight: 850; text-underline-offset: .22em; } .ds-project-card a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ffe66d; outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-label { margin: 0; font-size: .73rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .05em; }

narrative.overview: This is a small, direct gallery for real browser tools. The framing stays deep and quiet; each project enters as a brightly coloured object with a purpose-built line illustration. It should feel like opening a concise, well-organised shelf rather than browsing a generic portfolio.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet navy frame with high-contrast, large-scale type.
Each project is a colour-coded object, not an interchangeable content tile.
Geometric line art explains the tool before the visitor reads the description.
One visible action per project: open the live tool.

rules.name: Distinct Tool Rule
rules.body: Every project gets one coloured art field and one pale content field; do not introduce a fourth accent or blend the projects into one brand colour.

rules.name: Direct Language Rule
rules.body: Headings name the useful thing. Labels support orientation; they never become decorative copy.

rules.name: Lift Only on Intent Rule
rules.body: Depth is a response to a hover or focus interaction, never permanent decoration.

dos: Do keep every card tied to a real project and a real deployment URL.
Do author simple subject-specific SVG geometry when an icon helps explain a tool.
Do preserve the dark shelf plus distinct coloured tool worlds as the collection grows.
Do make keyboard focus and reduced-motion support visible in the implementation.
donts: Don't use generic portfolio thumbnails, stock-device mockups, or interchangeable icon cards.
Don't add sign-up prompts, trackers, forms, user storage, or third-party font requests.
Don't add decorative grid backgrounds, gradient text, glass panels, or floating metric widgets.
